SELECT installer_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE installer_name <> '-1' AND installer_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of federal civil cases had a party representing itself?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN try_cast(pro_se AS double) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_courts.fjc_integrated_database WHERE pro_se IS NOT NULL
Which compounds have the most negative measured hydration free energy in the solvation benchmark?
SELECT iupac, expt FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_sampl ORDER BY expt ASC LIMIT 10
When does the New York grid operator's fuel mix record begin?
SELECT min(date_parse(time_stamp, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%i:%s')) AS first_reading FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix
What are the densest materials the Materials Project has computed?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(density AS double) AS density_g_cm3 FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the largest HOMO–LUMO gap among QM9 molecules?
SELECT max(gap) AS highest FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_qm9
Which states have the most facilities tracked by EPA's enforcement system?
SELECT fac_state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE fac_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many court opinions were filed in each decade since 1930?
SELECT concat(substr(date_filed, 1, 3), '0s') AS decade, count(*) AS opinions FROM govblock_courts.opinion_clusters WHERE date_filed >= '1930' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which states have the most facilities reporting greenhouse gases in 2023?
SELECT state_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.ghg_dim_facility WHERE year = '2023' AND state_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of patent applications come from small and micro entities rather than large ones?

SELECT entity_type, count(*) AS applications, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE entity_type <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which counties are most specialised in oil and gas extraction jobs?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.area_title, try_cast(q.lq_annual_avg_emplvl AS double) AS location_quotient FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_area_titles AS t ON t.area_fips = q.area_fips WHERE q.agglvl_code = '75' AND q.own_code = '5' AND q.industry_code = '211' AND q.year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How much more does a 64-year-old pay than a 21-year-old for marketplace coverage in Georgia? (2021)

SELECT age, avg(try_cast(individualrate AS double)) AS avg_monthly_premium FROM govblock_health.marketplace_rate_puf WHERE statecode = 'GA' AND cast(businessyear AS varchar) = '2021' AND age IN ('21', '64') AND tobacco <> 'Tobacco User' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which community water systems serve the most people?

SELECT pws_name, try_cast(population_served_count AS double) AS population_served_count FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of ZIP code rate listings are served by electric cooperatives?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN ownership = 'Cooperative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_solar.urdb_zip_rates
On what grounds do patent examiners reject claims most often?

SELECT CASE action_type WHEN '101' THEN 'not patentable subject matter (101)' WHEN '102' THEN 'not new (102)' WHEN '103' THEN 'obvious (103)' WHEN '112' THEN 'unclear or unsupported (112)' ELSE action_type END AS ground, count(*) AS rejections FROM govblock_patents.oa_research_rejections GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many facilities in Texas have a significant violation under EPA rules?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE fac_state = 'TX' AND fac_compliance_status = 'Significant Violation'
Which Navy offices posted the most solicitations in 2024?
SELECT office, count(*) AS notices FROM govblock_awards.sam_opportunities WHERE subtier = 'DEPT OF THE NAVY' AND type = 'Solicitation' AND posteddate LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many U.S. patent applications have been published?
Which New York counties have the highest average rent paid by subsidized tenants?

SELECT name, try_cast(rent_per_month AS double) AS rent_per_month FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE states = 'NY New York' AND program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How did lead releases to water in Ohio change from 2000 to 2022?

SELECT _1_year, sum(try_cast(_53_53_water AS double)) AS water_release FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _8_st = 'OH' AND _37_chemical LIKE 'LEAD%' AND cast(_1_year AS varchar) IN ('2000', '2022') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which larger colleges admit the smallest share of applicants?

SELECT instnm, try_cast(adm_rate AS double) AS admission_rate FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE try_cast(adm_rate AS double) > 0 AND try_cast(ugds AS double) >= 1000 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many lenders filed HMDA mortgage data for 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT lei) AS lenders FROM govblock_finance.hmda_ts WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023'
Which states spend the most on Ozempic through Medicare Part D?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_state_abrvtn, sum(try_cast(tot_drug_cst AS double)) AS cost FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE brnd_name = 'Ozempic' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

In which years was the most coal-fired generating capacity retired?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled

SELECT retirement_year, round(sum(mw)) AS retired_mw FROM (SELECT retirement_year, plant_code, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_retired_and_canceled WHERE status = 'RE' AND energy_source_1 IN ('BIT', 'SUB', 'LIG', 'RC', 'WC') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did wind or nuclear plants generate more electricity in 2024?

SELECT CASE series_id WHEN 'ELEC.GEN.WND-US-99.A' THEN 'Wind' ELSE 'Nuclear' END AS source, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id IN ('ELEC.GEN.WND-US-99.A', 'ELEC.GEN.NUC-US-99.A') AND period = '2024'
Which areas have the highest fair market rent for a two-bedroom apartment?
SELECT areaname, max(try_cast(fmr2 AS double)) AS two_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average U.S. price of regular gasoline in the week of June 13, 2022?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_gallon FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.EMM_EPMR_PTE_NUS_DPG.W' AND period = '20220613'
Were there more road deaths in 2019, before the pandemic, or in 2021?
SELECT year, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2019', '2021') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which medical subject headings are used most often as a paper's major topic?
SELECT descriptor_name, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_mesh WHERE major_topic = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were the Department of Education's net outlays for fiscal 2023?
SELECT try_cast(current_fytd_net_outly_amt AS double) AS net_outlays FROM govblock_treasury.mts_table_5 WHERE record_date = '2023-09-30' AND classification_desc = 'Total--Department of Education'
Which public universities charge out-of-state students the most in tuition and fees?
SELECT instnm, try_cast(tuitionfee_out AS double) AS out_of_state FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE cast(control AS varchar) = '1' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How did the number of utility patents granted change from 2000 to 2024?

SELECT substr(patent_date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE patent_type = 'utility' AND substr(patent_date, 1, 4) IN ('2000', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
What was the highest statewide load NYISO forecast for any hour of 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(nyiso AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_load_forecast_isolf WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2024'
How did total U.S. energy consumption change from 1960 to 2023?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id = 'SEDS.TETCB.US.A' AND period IN ('1960', '2023') ORDER BY 1
What was the highest yield at any 10-year note auction in 2023?
SELECT max(try_cast(high_yield AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_treasury.auctions_query WHERE security_term = '10-Year' AND security_type = 'Note' AND substr(auction_date, 1, 4) = '2023'
Which state house districts have the most voting-age citizens?
Eligible Voters by State House District
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_sldlc WHERE lntitle = 'Total' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many appeals arose from judgments entered in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.originating_court_information WHERE substr(cast(date_judgment AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2024'
Which service occupations get the highest Service Contract Act wage rates?
SELECT occupation_title, round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_sca_rates GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 50 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people lived in Texas according to the 2024 one-year survey?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0400000US48' AND variable = 'B01003_E001'
Which completed trials enrolled the most people?
SELECT nct_id, brief_title, enrollment FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE overall_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY try_cast(enrollment AS integer) DESC LIMIT 10
How many households in Manhattan rent their home?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36061' AND variable = 'B25003_E003'
How many chemical reactions were extracted from U.S. patents granted in 2010?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants WHERE year = '2010'
How many patent applications were filed in each of the last ten years?
SELECT substr(filing_date, 6, 4) AS year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE length(filing_date) = 9 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which kinds of outside identifiers does PubChem record most often?
SELECT c2, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_identifiers WHERE c2 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
